name: EMERGENCY_24_HR_SYMBOL_BLUE_SQUARE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. DIT symbol sheet (Symbol Series: a sign component published as its own drawing; used on service, tourist and warning signs at the percentage each sign sheet states). Sheet S110 (24 hr emergency service symbol, hospital): white cross as S1 (177 square, 40 from the top); 24 in 60 E (112) + 45 + hr 60 E lower case (75), baseline 330 (20 from the bottom; 59 margins). Layout: 350 x 350, blue, R0, no border. Legend placed from the sheet's own filled artwork measured at 1200 dpi (letter heights from the ink, series confirmed by the FHWA widths, each word centred on its ink; the sheet's dimension chains were not transcribed one by one for this sign — the positions are the sheet's drawn artwork itself, which the overlay check confirms): 24 60 E white top 270 x 59-171 (112); hr 60 E white top 270 x 217-291 (75).
